corridor_notes: 苏皖天然气管道联络线 (Jiangsu-Anhui gas pipeline connecting/liaison line), a SEPARATE, earlier project from the Nov-2025-approved 苏皖豫干线 main network (not mentioned in the MEE Nov-2025 approval) — under construction per GEM's Status field. Per Xuancheng municipal government's EIA public-participation notice: '起点为苏皖天然气管道两省交界处连接点（新杭镇板桥村），终点为拟新建的新杭输气枢纽站（S338国道南侧），线路全长约16.3Km，管径D610mm，设计压力6.3MPa' (starts at the Jiangsu-Anhui provincial-border connection point at Banqiao Village, Xinhang Town; ends at the proposed Xinhang Gas Transmission Hub Station, south of national/provincial road S338; ~16.3 km, DN610mm, 6.3 MPa). Built in Guangde City (广德市), Xuancheng (宣城市), Anhui. Route also crosses/near Xiahenggang, Dongcuo village, and Wufeng village, and provincial road S458, per related Guangde-government notices for the same project. Note: the source itself labels S338 inconsistently as '国道' (national road) even though S-prefixed roads are normally provincial (省道) in China's numbering — flagged, not resolved, matches GEM's 'S338 Provincial Road' EndLocation.
researcher_notes: Exact match to GEM's fields: StartLocation 'Banqiao Village' = 板桥村; EndLocation 'S338 Provincial Road' = the S338-adjacent proposed hub station; length 16.3 km matches GEM's LengthMergedKm exactly; province Anhui matches. Confirmed by the Xuancheng municipal government's own EIA public-participation notice (verbatim quote above), corroborated by a second, related Guangde-government EIA notice describing the same route through Banqiao/Xiahenggang/Dongcuo/Wufeng villages crossing S458 and S338.
blockers: Start and end are only ~16km apart and both resolve to the same Xinhang-town-level OSM centroid — Nominatim has no finer feature for either the border connection point or the proposed hub station, so the two endpoint coordinates in this file are identical even though they represent distinct points along the corridor. A human GIS pass against the Xuancheng/Guangde EIA notices (which name intermediate villages: Xiahenggang, Dongcuo, Wufeng) could differentiate start vs. end more precisely.
